item.tib: gsang don rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba thar lam gsal ba'i sgron ma
item.coloph: de ltar gsang don rnam par 'byed pa'i lde mig gi 'grel ba thar lam gsal ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba 'di/ snang zhig ston pashes rab blo ldan dbang gi rgyal po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor 'ching ba'i slob 'bang yongs kyi tha shal ba gshen gyi btsun gzugs tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bdag la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yongs 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho dpal bzang po de nyid kyi bka' nan gser gyi thig pa gtsug tu yang yang babs pa dang / rang gi nye 'bang bsod nams ye shes sogs slob ma 'ga' yis nye bar bskul ba la brten nas rang yang bdag 'dra'i blo dman la phan sems cher skyes te bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed du dmigs nas/ gshen bstan g.yung drung gling du bkod pa 'di yang rgyal bstan mdzes pa'i cha rkyen du gyur cig/
